cyc3_jafs_c_toggle_prepare.description: Disposable world only, enabled JAFS and long-lived compatibility apple; prepares one initial meal. Never run on resume.

cyc3_jafs_c_toggle_seed.description: Only after after_food observations independently confirm one accepted apple and max120; seeds110 once before first persistence boundary.

cyc3_jafs_c_toggle_resume.description: First observation after a full process restart; binds session but never clears food, eats, reloads definitions, refreshes cache or refills mana.

cyc3_jafs_c_toggle_disabled.description: Restart with installed compatible JAFS and master off, same save/definition. Expect native food retained, metadata available, no food provider,100/100; tooltip values may remain.

cyc3_jafs_c_toggle_save.description: After the preceding observation passed; saves current food/player state without refreshing duration or mana. Owner then closes the actual client process.

cyc3_jafs_c_toggle_remove.description: Only after re-enabled observation confirms same food/current100/max120; native clear must remove the single bonus without refund.
